title: Juniper and the Static
author: Wren Ishikawa
blurb: Petra Marchetti, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
